scope: Current user-facing Quark features and shared behaviour handlers; native host integration remains a manual release gate.

features.feature: Settings view save and blocked persistence
Unified header and dominant left sidebar
Bottom panel toggle button and shortcut
Command Palette filtering and empty results
Go to File filtering and opening
Workspace search limits and unreadable files
Stale and failed workspace search workers
Streaming stdout stderr and exit code
Real PTY handles and persistent shell state
Terminal copy and Ctrl C interrupt
Native document open, atomic save and external modification safety
Cross-platform visual designer layout compatibility, hit testing, persistence and validation
Native workspace recent items can be reopened without duplication and with persistent state
Separate native Start Window recent-project search, grouping, pinning and removal
Create Hydrogen projects and discover existing project manifests
Validate repository URLs and local clone destinations safely
Migrate recent projects without duplicates or restoring removed items
Visual Studio Professional-style menus, launcher actions and native tool-window structure
Distinguish Run Without Debugging from unsupported source-level debugging
Bundle generated binary outputs into a ZIP without claiming unbuilt artifacts exist
Build commands check project prerequisites and Clean preserves sources
Collapsible pinned/today/week/month/older groups with search showing matching projects
Properties grid edits X/Y/width/height safely and preserves layout geometry
Bundle/publish requires a successful fresh build and does not publish stale binaries
Visual Studio-style native pane divider positions persist and reset safely between sessions
Native searchable toolbox has thirteen grouped design-time controls that round-trip in .quarkui layouts
Existing Quark designer and native UI designer can round-trip all thirteen .quarkui control kinds without data loss
Empty full-IDE workspace has no in-window Start page or fake document tabs and restores blank after project closure
Compact vertically written native tool-window tabs and Hydrogen cyan/orbital blue/Quark violet accent without replacing OS widgets
User-resizable pane handles and buttons update persisted widths/heights, while OS window resizing only affects the editor/designer Fill tracks
